findings: components[1].sound[1].text: Modern Mandarin readings are transcribed incorrectly as 馬 mǎ and 媽 mā for the entry character 妈; that pair compares traditional 媽 with 馬 and cannot verify 妈 against the exact local Unihan row. Change the sound comparison to component_form 马, component_reading mǎ, character_reading mā, system Modern Standard Mandarin, and explain that this present-day resemblance does not establish the historical sound relationship.
